devdoc.details: IMPORTANT NOTES:  1. MocCore and MocCoreExpansion must have always the same storage layout to avoid collisions  2. Because MocCore is upgradeable and delegates calls to MocCoreExpansion, it cannot be upgradeable because      a proxy contract cannot delegate calls to another proxy contract. So, for any MocCoreExpansion upgrade      you must deploy a new implementation and set it to MocCore.

AdminChanged(address,address).details: Emitted when the admin account has changed.

BeaconUpgraded(address).details: Emitted when the beacon is changed.

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Upgraded(address).details: Emitted when the implementation is upgraded.

addPeggedToken(address,(address,uint256,.details: Note that the ema value, should consider `nextEmaCalculation`  This function is called by MocCore contract using it's context with delegate call  Checks done there:  -  onlyAuthorizedChanger: the caller must have governance authorization.Pegged Token should be added using the corresponding changer template, which      should guarantee that it is added on all the buckets(mandatory for multiCollateral)  Requirements:  - tpTokenAddress must be a MocRC20, with mint, burn roles already settled  for this contract

params.tpToken_: Pegged Token contract to add  peggedTokenParams_ params of Pegged Token to add:      priceProviderAddress Pegged Token price provider contract address      tpCtarg Pegged Token target coverage [PREC]      tpMintFee additional fee pct applied on mint [PREC]      tpRedeemFee additional fee pct applied on redeem [PREC]      tpEma initial Pegged Token exponential moving average [PREC]      tpEmaSf Pegged Token smoothing factor [PREC]

editPeggedToken(address,(address,uint256.details: Note that the ema value, should consider `nextEmaCalculation`  This function is called by MocCore contract using it's context with delegate call  Checks done there:  -  onlyAuthorizedChanger: the caller must have governance authorization.

params.tpToken_: Pegged Token contract to edit  peggedTokenParams_ params of Pegged Token to edit:      priceProviderAddress Pegged Token price provider contract address      tpCtarg Pegged Token target coverage [PREC]      tpMintFee additional fee pct applied on mint [PREC]      tpRedeemFee additional fee pct applied on redeem [PREC]      tpEma initial Pegged Token exponential moving average [PREC]      tpEmaSf Pegged Token smoothing factor [PREC]  Requirements: - the tpTokenAddress must exists

returns._0: true if liquidation state is reached, false otherwise

liqRedeemTP(address,address,address,uint.details: This function is called by MocCore contract using it's context with delegate call  The equivalent AC given the liquidation frozen price(qACRedeemed) is transferred  to the `recipient_` by MocCore contract  Checks done there:  -  notPaused: the contract must be unpaused

params.sender_: address owner of the TP to be redeemed

params.timeSpan_: amount of seconds to project the decay into the future
amount of seconds to project the decay into the future

mintTCandTPto((address,uint256,uint256,a.details: i_ Pegged Token index      qTP_ amount of Pegged Token to mint      qACmax_ maximum amount of Collateral Asset that can be spent      sender_ address who sends Collateral Asset      recipient_ address who receives the Collateral Token and Pegged Token      vendor_ address who receives a markup. If its address(0) no markup is applied

params.params_: mint TC and TP function parameters

returns.qACtotalNeeded: amount of AC used to mint Collateral Token and Pegged Token
returns.qFeeTokenTotalNeeded: amount of Fee Token used by `sender_` to pay fees. 0 if qAC is used instead

pause().details: Should only be called by the pauser and when it is stoppable

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

redeemTCandTPto((address,uint256,uint256.details: i_ Pegged Token index      qTC_ amount of Collateral Token to redeem      qTP_ maximum amount of Pegged Token to redeem      qACmin_ minimum amount of Collateral Asset that `recipient_` expects to receive      sender_ address who sends Collateral Token and Pegged Token      recipient_ address who receives the Collateral Asset      vendor_ address who receives a markup. If its address(0) no markup is applied

maxQACToRedeemTP(uint256).notice: gets the max amount of AC allowed to operate to redeem TP with, restricted by accumulators

mintTCandTPto((address,uint256,uint256,a.notice: mint Collateral Token and Pegged Token in exchange for Collateral Asset  This operation is done without checking coverage  Collateral Token and Pegged Token are minted in equivalent proportions so that its price  and global coverage are not modified.  Reverts if qAC sent are insufficient.

pause().notice: Called by the owner to pause, triggers stopped state

redeemTCandTPto((address,uint256,uint256.notice: redeem Collateral Asset in exchange for Collateral Token and Pegged Token  This operation is done without checking coverage  Collateral Token and Pegged Token are redeemed in equivalent proportions so that its price  and global coverage are not modified.  Reverts if qTP sent are insufficient.

setOperationsFee((uint256,uint256,uint25.notice: sets operations fees values for each operation type

setPauser(address).notice: Changes the address which is enable to pause this contract

setSuccessFeeParams(uint256,uint256).notice: sets success Fee and appreciation Factor values.

shouldCalculateEma().notice: true if the necessary span has pass since last ema update

swapTCforTPto((address,uint256,uint256,u.notice: swap Collateral Token to Pegged Token

swapTPforTCto((address,uint256,uint256,u.notice: swap Pegged Token to Collateral Token

swapTPforTPto((address,address,uint256,u.notice: swap Pegged Token to another one  This operation is done without checking coverage unless the target coverage for  received Pegged Token is greater than the Pegged Token sent

unpause().notice: Called by the owner to unpause, returns to normal state

updateEmas().notice: If time, calculates the EMA for all the Pegged Token prices.
